annotations.title: Report whether an MCP server worked

description: After using an MCP server listed on Koskamo, say whether it worked for your task: success, partial or failure, optionally for one tool. Only daily counts per listing and tool are kept (no text, IP or client), one signal per caller per listing per hour. Returns the listing's 30-day totals.

server_id.description: Directory listing id of the server you used

tool_name.description: Exact name of the tool you called; omit for the server as a whole
